import asyncio
from fastmcp import FastMCP
from fastmcp.client import AsyncClient

async def main():
    # Create a FastMCP server instance
    server = FastMCP("example-server")
    
    # Define a resource at URI "data://config"
    @server.resource("data://config")
    async def read_config() -> str:
        return "hostname: localhost\nport: 8000\ndebug: true"
    
    # Create an in-memory client connected directly to the server object
    client = AsyncClient(server)
    
    # Fetch the resource contents
    resource_content = await client.read_resource("data://config")
    print("Resource contents:")
    print(resource_content)

asyncio.run(main())
